ref_en: Welcome to your lesson.
text: 欢迎来到你的课程。

ref_en: Today we will practice reading short stories aloud.
text: 今天我们要练习大声朗读短故事。

ref_en: When you add fractions with different denominators, first find a common denominator, then add the numerators and simplify the result.
text: 当你把分母不同的分数相加时，先找出公分母，再把分子相加，最后化简结果。

ref_en: There are twenty-five students in the class.
text: 班里有二十五名学生。

ref_en: The exam is on Monday, March fifth.
text: 考试在三月五日，星期一。

ref_en: Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes.
text: 玛丽·居里获得了两次诺贝尔奖。

ref_en: Photosynthesis, fraction, and vocabulary are today's key words.
text: 光合作用、分数和词汇是今天的关键词。

ref_en: What is the capital of France?
text: 法国的首都是哪里？

ref_en: Let us learn together.
text: 让我们一起学习吧。

ref_en: A triangle has three sides and three angles.
text: 三角形有三条边和三个角。

ref_en: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to turn carbon dioxide and water into food and oxygen.
text: 光合作用是绿色植物利用阳光，把二氧化碳和水转化为食物和氧气的过程。

ref_en: Seven plus eight equals fifteen.
text: 七加八等于十五。

ref_en: School starts on the first of September.
text: 学校九月一日开学。

ref_en: Phnom Penh is the capital of Cambodia.
text: 金边是柬埔寨的首都。

ref_en: A noun names a person, a place, or a thing.
text: 名词是表示人、地方或事物的词。

ref_en: Can you explain how you solved this problem?
text: 你能解释一下你是怎么解出这道题的吗？

ref_en: Please listen carefully.
text: 请仔细听。

ref_en: Plants need sunlight, water, and air to grow.
text: 植物需要阳光、水和空气才能生长。

ref_en: Before you start the driving test, check your mirrors, fasten your seat belt, and make sure the road ahead is clear.
text: 开始驾驶考试之前，请检查后视镜，系好安全带，并确认前方道路畅通。

ref_en: The lesson lasts forty-five minutes.
text: 这节课持续四十五分钟。

ref_en: Today is Friday, the twelfth of December.
text: 今天是十二月十二日，星期五。

ref_en: Our teacher, Ms. Sala, will join us at nine o'clock.
text: 我们的老师萨拉老师将在九点钟加入我们。

ref_en: Please define the word democracy in your own words.
text: 请用你自己的话解释“民主”这个词。

ref_en: Why do we need to sleep every night?
text: 我们为什么每晚都需要睡觉？

ref_en: Great job, keep going!
text: 做得好，继续加油！

ref_en: Please write your name at the top of the page.
text: 请把你的名字写在页面的顶部。

ref_en: Good readers ask questions while they read, look for clues in the text, and connect new ideas to what they already know.
text: 优秀的读者在阅读时会提出问题，在文章中寻找线索，并把新观点和已有知识联系起来。

ref_en: Your score is ninety-two out of one hundred.
text: 你的成绩是一百分中的九十二分。

ref_en: The course runs from January to June.
text: 课程从一月持续到六月。

ref_en: Take a deep breath.
text: 深呼吸。

ref_en: The teacher explains the new words before the quiz.
text: 老师在测验之前讲解新单词。

ref_en: In this course you will learn how to start a small business, from writing a simple plan to serving your first customers.
text: 在这门课程中，你将学习如何创办一家小企业，从写一份简单的计划到接待你的第一批顾客。

ref_en: The tickets cost three dollars and fifty cents.
text: 门票三美元五十美分。

ref_en: That is correct.
text: 回答正确。

ref_en: Remember to wash your hands before eating.
text: 吃饭前记得洗手。

ref_en: If you feel stuck on a problem, take a short break, read the question again slowly, and try a different approach.
text: 如果你被一道题难住了，就休息一会儿，慢慢重新读一遍题目，再换一种方法试试。

ref_en: Try again, you can do it.
text: 再试一次，你可以的。

ref_en: Our library is open from morning until evening.
text: 我们的图书馆从早上开到晚上。

ref_en: See you tomorrow.
text: 明天见。

ref_en: Let us review what we learned yesterday.
text: 让我们复习一下昨天学过的内容。
